urdu.name: علاء
urdu.long_meaning: Aalaa (علاء) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم معظم، بلند، بزرگ ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: علاء

faq.a: Aalaa is associated with the Arabic form علاء, whose core sense is exalted, magnified, honoured.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aalaa?
faq.a: Aalaa is associated with Arabic. Aalaa is Arabic عَلَاء (ʿAlāʾ) 'exaltedness, highness', from the root ع ل و (ʿ-l-w). The source gloss 'Heavenly, Sublime' is broadly consistent.
Yes — the underlying form علاء is Arabic.
Aalaa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aalaa should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Aalaa mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aalaa is rendered علاء and carries the sense معظم، بلند، بزرگ.

faq.q: What does Aalaa mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Aalaa is rendered علاء and carries the sense معظم، بزرگ، سرفراز.
A romanized syllable approximation is aa-laa. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aalaa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aalaa, aalaa, ala. Script forms are علاء, अला.

faq.q: Is Aalaa a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
